_comment: Mine Site Task Management — Flow 2: Task Scoped
_instructions: Build this flow manually in Power Automate using Document 4 as your guide. Replace all [PLACEHOLDER] values.

flow.name: MineTasks_Flow2_TaskScoped
flow.description: Fires when a WorkTasks item is modified. Checks if Status changed to 'Scoped'. If yes, notifies the Task Scheduler via Teams and email, and posts to the department channel.

trigger.type: SharePoint - When an item is modified

actions.name: CheckIfScoped
actions.description: Only proceed if Status was updated to 'Scoped'. This prevents the flow firing on every field change.

actions.name: GetDepartmentContact
actions.description: Inside YES branch: looks up manager/scheduler contact

actions.name: ParallelBranch
actions.description: Runs Teams notification and email simultaneously for speed

branchA.name: TeamsMessageToSchedulingChannel
branchA.message: Task scoped and ready for scheduling. Full details including crew, equipment, permits, duration.

branchB.name: EmailToScheduler
branchB.subject: [SCHEDULE REQUIRED] @{triggerOutputs()?['body/Title']} — @{triggerOutputs()?['body/Department/Value']}
branchB.body: See Document 4, Step 5 Branch B for the full HTML email body

actions.name: PostToDepartmentChannel
actions.description: Posts a summary to the relevant department channel after parallel branch completes
actions.channel: Dynamic — matches department name (Mine Planning / Mine Services / Load & Haul / Drill & Blast / Dragline)
actions.message: Task scoped notification with department, supervisor, and priority details

actions.name: TerminateIfNotScoped
actions.description: Gracefully exits if the status change was not to 'Scoped'
